name: themes
description: Backdrop themes for the Claude Code desktop app. The first, bedroom, is a teenager's bedroom in the country, about 2004, drawn as one SVG with a lighting shader that follows the time of day and the weather. It has a hallway, a television that reacts to Claude, sound (off by default), things to click (television, VCR, console, computer, lamps) and a /bedroom command.

time.title: Bedroom: time of day
time.description: auto follows the clock; a phase holds that light all day.

sunrise.title: Bedroom: sunrise
sunrise.description: auto follows the season, worked out for 40 degrees north; or a local time HH:MM from 04:00 to 09:00, held all year.

sunset.title: Bedroom: sunset
sunset.description: auto follows the season, worked out for 40 degrees north; or a local time HH:MM from 16:00 to 22:00, held all year.

weather.title: Bedroom: weather
weather.description: auto changes by itself every three hours and never picks a storm.

lightning.title: Bedroom: lightning in a storm
lightning.description: rare: about one strike in three minutes; normal: about two a minute; often: about three a minute.

sound.title: Bedroom: sound
sound.description: Cicadas, crickets and katydids, rain, a downpour or a storm, thunder, the television and the room's things. Off by default.

soundPlayer.title: Bedroom: sound player
soundPlayer.description: Empty: found at run time. Else a command line with {file} where the sound file goes and {volume} for 0 to 100.

signal.title: Bedroom: television reacts to Claude
signal.description: The screen flickers while Claude works.

hall.title: Bedroom: hallway
hall.description: Now and then someone passes the door, or the hall light comes on.

shader.title: Bedroom: shader
shader.description: For diagnosis. Off: the hand-drawn room alone, with no fades, clock or lamp light, sent again on every change.
